phases.name: The Seven Gates Open
phases.say: Every one of you will come down to me in the end. Why not now?

say.open: You walk on my roof. Pay the toll, or come inside.
say.death: The gates... are closing... from the wrong side...

bestiary.lore: A god of plague and the underworld, older than the kingdom, who found the Barrows to his liking and set up court among the dead.
bestiary.weakness: Holy, heavily. Cure disease quickly: it spreads through a row.
bestiary.pattern: The Gate of Dust on three rows every third turn, plague on a row every other, the mace on the weakest between. At half the gate comes every other turn and he heals himself when low.
